events.subtitle: Debut performance
events.factual_description: Brandon Woody's official calendar and Current Space's authorized ticket listing announce Brandon Woody's BIG Band at Current Space Garden Bar, 421 Tyson Street, Baltimore, on Friday, September 11, 2026. Doors are at 19:00 and music starts at 20:00; the event is all ages and outdoors in Current Space's rear courtyard. Both sources explicitly identify the show as the debut performance of Woody's BIG Band, and Current Space describes it as a special 16-piece performance. The authorized event listing publishes personnel across four trumpets, five saxophones, four trombones, keys, basses, and drums; those names are preserved as listed without inferring seating, doubling, or which bassist may play at a given moment. Posted face prices are $22 advance and $26 day of show, with a limited $20 student ticket requiring student ID. Brandon Woody's official site identifies him as a Baltimore-born trumpeter, composer, and bandleader whose work draws on jazz, gospel, improvisation, and broader Black-music traditions.

en.why_it_matters: Woody is not simply bringing Upendo back for another Baltimore date; he is opening a new large-ensemble chapter in the city that shaped him. Putting his trumpet voice inside a full brass-and-reed architecture changes the scale of the music, and the published personnel pulls together a deep Baltimore/DC-area jazz bench around that experiment. Hearing the BIG Band at its debut gives the night a real point in the story: this is the first public test of how Woody's communal, rhythm-forward language expands when the canvas suddenly gets much bigger.
en.trip_verdict: From the DMV, this is worth the short run to Baltimore if September 11 is open; I would actively make room for Current Space rather than wait for a routine club return. It does not require a broader Northeast trip, and there is no evidence that this debut is the only chance the big band will ever have to play.

es.why_it_matters: Woody no está simplemente regresando con Upendo para otra fecha en Baltimore: está abriendo un capítulo de gran ensamble en la ciudad que lo formó. Meter su voz de trompeta dentro de una arquitectura completa de metales y maderas cambia la escala de la música, y el personal anunciado reúne una buena parte de la escena de jazz de Baltimore y el área de DC alrededor de ese experimento. Escuchar a la BIG Band en su debut le da a la noche un lugar concreto en la historia: es la primera prueba pública de cómo se expande el lenguaje comunitario y rítmico de Woody cuando de pronto el lienzo se vuelve mucho más grande.
es.trip_verdict: Desde el DMV sí haría el viaje corto a Baltimore si el 11 de septiembre está libre; le haría espacio activamente a Current Space en vez de esperar una vuelta rutinaria de club. No hace falta construir un viaje más amplio por el Northeast, y no hay evidencia de que este debut sea la única oportunidad que vaya a tener la big band para tocar.
